name: message-error
title: Message Error
description: Why a turn failed and what comes next, where its answer would have gone: an outlined card in the page's greys, an alert's triangle, the reason in a line and, under it, what it means or, while the app waits to try again, a countdown to it and which attempt that is; "Retry now" or the app's own action ("Continue") at its end. Its status, told by its mark and words, not a colour: waiting (a clock, the countdown), retrying (a spinner), exhausted ("Gave up after 5 attempts"), failed, cancelled, unknown (no answer: it may have gone through, check before trying again); several actions of the app's wrap at its end; nothing is tried on its own, the countdown's end only says it retries.
